# fanferro

> fanferro is an asyncio Python library (Rust core) for Amazon SNS + SQS: publishing with
> CloudEvents envelopes and pluggable codecs, consumers with routing, retries, dead-letter queues,
> visibility heartbeats and graceful shutdown, FIFO ordering, large payloads via S3 claim checks,
> declarative provisioning, transactional outbox, idempotency, OpenTelemetry, and an in-memory
> broker for tests.

Usage guide for AI agents (also `fanferro guide`): python/fanferro/AGENT_GUIDE.md
